summary: Iter-42 Phase 15 FRONTEND retest — ALL UI flows pass end-to-end. Backend tests not re-run per main agent instructions (iter-41 100% pass unchanged).
critical_code_review_comments: AddWidgetPicker correctly resets selection on every open (useEffect line 197). State is local — clean.
Profile.jsx addWidgets (line ~325) explicitly defaults size:'medium' for newly-added widgets — defensive and matches spec.
FounderProfile applies ALLOWED_WIDGET_TYPES filter both for SortableContext items AND render map — defense in depth against legacy widgets in DB.
Backdrop click closes modal correctly (line 215 onClick={onClose}) — verified does NOT add anything since save() is only fired via add-widget-save-many button.
Polls idempotency works via unique (widget_id, user_id) DB index (verified by re-vote → total stays 1).
Notes (500) and Blog (2000) char counters use maxLength on textarea + live JS counter — clean dual-layer enforcement.
Public profile (FounderProfile) NotesBody/BlogBody render saved content cleanly for tfone viewing tftwo — share/shared widget body components are well-factored.
